Sentence Corrections, Error Detection, V.question: ৩০) ‘You will be helped by me.’ বাক্যটির active form হবে -
Sentence Corrections, Error Detection, V.option1: ক) I shall have helped you.
Sentence Corrections, Error Detection, V.option4: ঘ) I will be helped you.
Sentence Corrections, Error Detection, V.exp:
Shall/will + be + (v1 + ing) যুক্ত Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তর ।
Active: Sub + shall/will + v1 + Object
Passive: Object টি subject হয় + shall/will + be + v3 + by + subject টি Object হয়।
